title: Are we going back to the 2000s celebrity fragrance wardrobe era?
summary: With a plethora of celebrities entering fragrance, from rappers Megan Thee Stallion and Ice Spice to singer Tate McRae, perfume collections are beginning to reflect the A-list-founded wardrobes of the early 2000s. But can celebrity fragrance find itself at the forefront once again?
